message.content:
Lasagna is a classic Italian dish that layers pasta sheets with rich sauces, cheeses, and often meat or vegetables. While there are many variations, here’s a basic recipe for a traditional meat lasagna:

### Ingredients

| Category | Item | Quantity (for 8–10 servings) |
|----------|------|------------------------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna noodles (no-boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Sauce** | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| **Meat** | Ground beef (80/20) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| **Meat** | Ground pork (optional, for richer flavor) | ½ lb (225 g) |
| **Vegetables** | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| **Vegetables** | Garlic cloves, minced | 3–4 |
| **Canned tomatoes** | Crushed tomatoes | 28 oz (800 g) |
| **Tomato paste** | 6 oz (170 g) |
| **Seasoning** | Salt | 1 tsp (adjust to taste) |
| **Seasoning** | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| **Seasoning** | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| **Seasoning** | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| **Seasoning** | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp |
| **Herbs** | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| **Cheese** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| **Cheese** | Mozzarella, shredded | 16 oz (450 g) |
| **Cheese** | Parmesan, grated | ½ cup (50 g) |
| **Egg** | Large egg (for ricotta mixture) | 1 |
| **Liquid** | Milk (optional, for ricotta mixture) | ¼ cup (60 ml) |
| **Optional** | Spinach, wilted (fresh or frozen) | 2 cups (if desired) |
| **Optional** | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup (if desired) |

### Notes & Tips

- **No‑boil noodles**: If you’re short on time, use no‑boil lasagna sheets; they’ll cook during baking. If you prefer regular sheets, pre‑cook them until al dente, then drain and rinse with cold water to prevent sticking.
- **Meat sauce**: Brown the meats first, then add onions and garlic until translucent. Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, seasonings, and simmer for at least 30 minutes to develop flavor.
- **Ricotta mixture**: Combine ricotta, egg, milk (if using), half of the grated Parmesan, salt, pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg. This adds richness and helps bind the layers.
- **Layering**: Start with a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of your baking dish, then alternate layers of noodles, ricotta mixture, meat sauce, spinach/mushrooms (if using), shredded mozzarella, and a sprinkle of Parmesan. Finish with a generous topping of mozzarella and Parmesan.
- **Baking**: Cover with foil (to prevent sticking, you can spray the underside of the foil with cooking spray) and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 25 minutes until bubbly and golden. Let rest 10–15 minutes before serving.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
